aboutSub: Registered migration agent Pushminder Singh Bedi, Point Cook.
aboutParas: Wise Advice Visa & Immigration Services is run by Pushminder Singh Bedi, a registered migration agent (MARN 2318254) based at 21 Parliament St, Point Cook.

Pushminder holds a Graduate Diploma in Migration Law from Victoria University and has worked in immigration for many years. He helps with student, partner, parent, skilled, business and visitor visas, citizenship and appeals.
You can talk to him in Punjabi, Hindi or English, seven days a week.
